name: Louisiana

statute.name: Louisiana Public Records Act
statute.citation: La. Rev. Stat. Ann. § 44:1 et seq. (requesters § 44:31; response § 44:32(D); suit § 44:35)

response.rule_text: Custodian must respond within three days, exclusive of Saturdays, Sundays and legal public holidays, even if still deciding what may be withheld, La. Rev. Stat. Ann. § 44:32(D).

fees.labor_rule: No fee to examine or review records except for after-hours examination; no examination fees otherwise.
fees.waiver_rule: Copies may be furnished free or at reduced charge to indigent persons of the state.

residency.rule_text: 'Any person of the age of majority' may request, La. Rev. Stat. Ann. § 44:31 (age limit, not residency); only the actual requester has standing to sue (Vourvoulais).

appeal.body: District court for the parish where the custodian sits
appeal.rule_text: No administrative appeal and no AG/ombudsman enforcement; requester may sue for injunction or mandamus, La. Rev. Stat. Ann. § 44:35(B), and may file five days after the request if no response (passage of time treated as denial).

notes: Governor's records covered but intraoffice communications of governor and staff may be privileged (§ 44:5). Silence treated as denial after passage of five days per RCFP text (truncated sentence). Appeal deadline null. Legislature/universities/school districts not confirmed. Search fee 'false' is inferred from no-examination-fee language, not an explicit ban on search labor.
